title: 第5章 情绪很稳定
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 夜深人静，一片漆黑。很多人家里都没有开灯，毕竟那是要交电费的。这个时代也没过多的娱乐节目，大多数人就是早早上床造小人。四合院里十几户人家早已熄灯，院子内漆黑一片。辰楠悄无声息地翻过院墙，生怕惊扰了邻里。看门的钱大爷这个点已经睡下，他可不想吵醒看门大爷，那么晚才回来他也解释不清。院子里空无一人，唯有月光如水，洒在青石板上，映出一片银白。他轻手轻脚走向自家房门，木门吱呀一声打开，又轻轻合上。屋里比外面更黑，辰楠摸黑走进里间，借着窗棂透进的月光，依稀间看清房子里的摆设。辰楠累得直接躺在床上。出去忙了大半夜，这具羸弱的身体也有些扛不住。躺了好一会，意念一动，辰楠转瞬间已置身于另一番天地。空间小世界里。一方天地被混沌迷雾包裹，一条溪水流淌过肥沃的黑土地，在远处的丛林大山映照下，俨然成了一幅山河图。一片空地上，二十几个箱子被随意摆放在一旁。每个箱子都是打开的，大黄鱼和古董字画整整齐齐堆在一旁，金灿灿的光芒看着晃迷了双眼。辰楠拿起箱子里的大黄鱼看了看。看了大黄鱼又拿起一些字画以及青花瓷仔细端详。好一会后他才走到一条溪水边上。这是一条约三米宽的蜿蜒溪水，把十几亩肥沃的黑土地一分为二。辰楠掬一捧清水饮下，顿觉神清气爽，身上暖洋洋的。一晚上的疲惫也一扫而空，就像是吃了大补药般。这泉水有奇特功效，饮之能消除疲劳，长期使用还有强身健体之功效。他扭头看向一旁的黑土地，只见那里一片绿，下午种下的南瓜苗在溪水的灌溉下已经生根发芽。他意念一动，一条细小的泉水小蛇朝着南瓜苗细细浇灌而去。奇妙的事情再次发生，嫩绿的南瓜苗叶子在微风中轻轻颤动，随即便慢慢生长。辰楠凝神聚气，将精神力灌注其中。只见那嫩芽迅速抽条生蔓，蜿蜒伸展，不一会儿就蔓延开来，绿油油地铺了一地。藤蔓上绽开朵朵黄花，在空间特有的微光中显得格外明亮。更让辰楠惊讶的是，这次催熟比从前容易许多。藤蔓上迅速开花结果，十分钟后就结出几个小小的果实，青翠可爱，在叶片间若隐若现。他心中欣喜，继续催动精神力。他知道消耗精神力的后果，于是他的身体也逐渐淡化，再次出现在床上。南瓜藤蔓疯狂生长，转眼间就覆盖了大片黑土地，几个嫩绿的南瓜逐渐有拳头那么大。辰楠只觉得一阵头晕目眩袭来，知道这是精神力耗尽的征兆，却也不甚在意。这种事情以前尝试多了，睡一觉便好。让辰楠诧异的是，这次精神力催生下，种子生长的速度比上一世更快。辰楠来不及细看，就眼前一黑，昏昏睡去。次日清晨。阳光透过纸窗的缝隙洒进来，在泥地上投下斑驳的光影。辰楠睁开眼，只觉得头脑清明，丝毫没有昨日精神力耗尽后的不适感。意念一动，意识进入空间。只见南瓜已经有拳头大，青翠的叶子铺了一大片黑土地，看上去生机勃勃。他用泉水浇灌，观察一遍见没什么问题才收回意念。外间传来窸窣的声响，母亲想必也出门工作，难道父亲还在家？他下床洗漱一番，就看见灶台上温着一碗稀粥和半个窝头，显然是留给他的。“小楠，醒了？”里间传来父亲的声音，带着些许疲惫。辰楠应了一声，端着粥走进里屋。父亲辰东南坐在椅子上，正在修补一个破旧的箩筐。早年间父亲的腿脚受伤，偶尔会风湿痛得受不了，因此疼痛的时候只有请假在家休息。辰楠看着父亲那双腿有些出神。既然占据了这具身体，那他就要替原主尽孝。“爸，吃过了吗？”辰楠问，声音不自觉地放柔了。辰东南点点头，手上的活计没停：“你妈留了饭，我吃过了。你快吃吧，粥该凉了。”辰楠喝着粥，目光却不离父亲的双腿。空间小世界里的灵泉溪水，能催生植物，对伤势也有不错的效果，这是他以前就尝试过的。若是用在老爸身上……“爸，您的腿今天感觉怎么样？”辰楠试探着问。辰东南苦笑一声，手上的动作顿了顿：“老样子，吃了些止疼药，医生说这辈子就这样了，明天就能去上班。”“也许...也许还有办法。”辰楠斟酌着用词，“我听说有些偏方...”“别费那个心了。”父亲打断他，声音里透着看透世事的沧桑，“这半年来看过多少大夫，吃过多少药，命该如此，强求不得。”辰楠低下头，粥碗在手中转着圈。他在想该如何合理地拿灵泉溪水给父亲使用。至少不能让人怀疑这事情是自已做的。“老爸，做人要有期望，总不能就这样放弃。”辰楠轻声说，“只要心中有希望，就一切皆有可能。”辰东南听了这话终于放下手中的箩筐，抬头看着儿子，眼中有着欣慰：“小楠啊，你长大了。”他直视辰楠的眼睛笑着开口：“爸这辈子最大的心愿，就是看着你们十兄妹平安长大。我的腿伤治不好没关系，只要你们好好的，我就安心了。”或许是身体的本能执念情绪，辰楠只觉得鼻子一酸，差点落下泪来。“爸，我一定会想办法的。”辰楠坚定地说，“无论如何，我都要试试，你要坚信自已还能站起来！”如今也只能给父亲一些鼓励以及希望，至于效果如何，到时候拭目以待。辰东南摇了摇头，但却是满眼的欣慰。虽然腿脚有些不便，但他现在还有工作，还可以养家，走路有些瘸，下雨天还会有风湿痛折磨，但这些事情都不能击垮他。但看到儿子如此担心，他也只能随口答应下来，“希望如此吧！不过别太勉强，咱们家现在经不起折腾了。”辰楠随即点点头，父亲这情绪还是很稳定的。从一个正常人到走路不便，还经常被疼痛折磨，一般这样的人情绪不是崩溃也会变得自暴自弃。就在这时。前院突然传来一阵嘈杂声，脚步声杂乱，还夹杂着男女的争吵声，那声音愈发的靠近自家门口。辰楠眉头一皱，那声音他再熟悉不过.......很快门就被敲响，还是被暴力敲响。再不开门，门就要被拍散架了……
content_en: It was dark in the dead of night.Many people don't turn on the lights at home, after all, they have to pay the electricity bill.There aren't many entertainment programs in this era. Most people just go to bed early and make villains.More than a dozen households in the courtyard had already turned off their lights, and the courtyard was pitch dark.Chen Nan climbed over the courtyard wall quietly, fearing to disturb the neighbors.The janitor Qian had already gone to bed at this time. He didn't want to wake him up, and he couldn't explain why he came back so late.There was no one in the yard, only the moonlight was like water, shining on the bluestone, reflecting a silvery white.He walked quietly to the door of his house. The wooden door opened with a creak and then closed gently.The room was darker than outside. Chen Nan walked into the inner room in the dark, and through the moonlight coming through the window lattice, he could vaguely see the furnishings in the house.Chen Nan was so tired that he lay down on the bed.After working out for most of the night, my frail body couldn't bear it anymore.After lying there for a while, Chen Nan suddenly felt like he was in another world.In the small world of space.The sky and the earth are wrapped in the mist of chaos, and a stream flows through the fertile black land. Reflected by the jungle mountains in the distance, it looks like a picture of mountains and rivers.In an open space, more than twenty boxes were randomly placed aside.Each box was open, and large yellow croakers and antique calligraphy and paintings were neatly piled aside. The golden light dazzled my eyes.Chen Nan picked up the large yellow croaker in the box and looked at it.After looking at the big yellow croaker, I picked up some calligraphy, paintings and blue and white porcelain and looked at them carefully.After a while, he came to a stream.This is a winding stream about three meters wide, dividing more than ten acres of fertile black land into two.Chen Nan took a handful of water and drank it, feeling refreshed and warm all over.The fatigue of the whole night was gone, as if I had taken a big tonic.This spring water has unique effects. Drinking it can relieve fatigue, and long-term use can also strengthen the body.He turned to look at the black soil beside him, and saw that it was all green. The pumpkin seedlings planted in the afternoon had taken root and sprouted under the irrigation of the stream.With a thought, a tiny spring water snake began to water the pumpkin seedlings.A wonderful thing happened again. The leaves of the tender green pumpkin seedlings trembled gently in the breeze, and then slowly grew.Chen Nan concentrated his energy and poured his spiritual power into it.I saw the buds quickly sprouting vines, winding and stretching, and soon they spread, spreading green all over the ground.Yellow flowers bloomed on the vines, which looked particularly bright in the unique dim light of the space.What surprised Chen Nan even more was that this time ripening was much easier than before.Flowers and fruits bloomed quickly on the vines, and within ten minutes several small fruits appeared, green and lovely, looming among the leaves.He was delighted and continued to stimulate his mental power.He knew the consequences of consuming mental energy, so his body gradually faded and reappeared on the bed.The pumpkin vines grew wildly, covering a large area of ​​black land in an instant, and several tender green pumpkins gradually became as big as a fist.Chen Nan only felt a wave of dizziness coming over him. He knew that this was a sign of mental exhaustion, but he didn't care much about it.I've tried this kind of thing many times before, and it'll be fine if I just sleep.What surprised Chen Nan was that the seeds grew faster this time due to the mental power than in the previous life.Before Chen Nan had time to take a closer look, his vision went dark and he fell asleep.Early next morning.The sun shines in through the gaps in the paper windows, casting mottled light and shadow on the dirt floor.Chen Nan opened his eyes and felt that his mind was clear and he didn't feel any discomfort after exhausting his mental energy yesterday.With a thought, consciousness enters the space.I saw that the pumpkin was already as big as a fist, and its green leaves covered a large area of ​​black soil, looking full of vitality.He used spring water to water it, and after observing it again and seeing that there was no problem, he took back his mind.There was a rustling sound outside. My mother must have gone out to work. Is my father still at home?He got out of bed to wash up, and saw a bowl of gruel and half a steamed bun warm on the stove, which were obviously left for him."Xiao Nan, are you awake?" Father's voice came from inside, a little tired.Chen Nan responded and walked into the back room with porridge.Father Chen Southeast was sitting on a chair, repairing an old basket.In his early years, my father's legs and feet were injured, and he occasionally suffered from unbearable rheumatic pain. Therefore, when he was in pain, he had to take time off to rest at home.Chen Nan looked at her father's legs in trance.Since he has taken over this body, he must fulfill his filial piety for the original owner."Dad, have you eaten?" Chen Nan asked, her voice softened unconsciously.Chen Nannan nodded and continued working on his hands: "Your mother left some rice and I ate it. Eat quickly, the porridge should be cold." Chen Nan drank the porridge without looking away from his father's legs.The spiritual spring water in the small world of space can promote the growth of plants and has a good effect on injuries. This is something he has tried before.If it were used on dad... "Dad, how do your legs feel today?" Chen Nan asked tentatively.Chen Nannan gave a wry smile and paused in his hand movements: "As usual, I took some painkillers. The doctor said that I will be like this for the rest of my life. I can go to work tomorrow." "Maybe... maybe there is a way." Chen Nan considered the words, "I heard that someHome remedies..." "Don't worry about it." His father interrupted him, his voice revealing the vicissitudes of life, "I've seen so many doctors and taken so many medicines in the past six months, this is what my destiny is, and I can't force it." Chen Nan lowered his head and turned the porridge bowl in his hands.He was thinking about how to reasonably use the water from Lingquan stream to his father.At least no one can doubt that he did it himself."Dad, you have to have expectations in life, and you can't just give up." Chen Nan said softly, "As long as there is hope in your heart, everything is possible." After hearing this, Chen Nannan finally put down the basket in his hand and looked up at his son, with relief in his eyes: "Xiao Nan, you have grown up." He looked directly at him.Chen Nan smiled and said, "Dad's biggest wish in this life is to see you ten brothers and sisters grow up safely. It doesn't matter if my leg injury is not cured, as long as you are well, I will feel at ease." Perhaps it was the body's instinctive obsession, Chen Nan felt a sore nose and almost shed tears."Dad, I will definitely find a way." Chen Nan said firmly, "No matter what, I have to try, you have to believe that you can still stand up!" Now I can only give my father some encouragement and hope. As for the effect, we will wait and see.Chen Southeast shook his head, but his eyes were filled with relief.Although he has some inconveniences in his legs and feet, he still has a job and can still support his family. He walks with a slight limp and suffers from rheumatic pain on rainy days, but none of these things can defeat him.But seeing his son so worried, he could only agree casually, "I hope so! But don't be too reluctant, our family can't stand the trouble now." Chen Nan nodded immediately, and his father's mood was still very stable.From being a normal person to having trouble walking and often being tortured by pain, such people usually either collapse emotionally or become self-defeating.Just then.Suddenly, there was a noise in the front yard, the footsteps were messy, and there was also the quarrel between men and women. The sound got closer and closer to the door of his house.Chen Nan frowned, that sound was all too familiar to him... Soon the door was knocked, and it was violently knocked.If you don't open the door, the door will fall apart...
